cpu_hooks.note: Scene timing covers the update_scene CPU system, not render-thread uploads, GPU execution or presentation.

capabilities.scope: enabled RenderDevice features; adapter support was not separately queried

notes: GPU values are real instrumented render-span timestamp durations already converted to milliseconds by Bevy using the queue timestamp period. The built-in scene spans measure render passes; encoder-only spans may also be reported.
CPU values are wall-clock time inside instrumented render encoding spans, not total render-thread CPU time, extraction, asset preparation, upload, presentation, or GPU execution.
Diagnostic timestamps are main-world delivery times. observed_main_frame identifies observation only, not the source render frame.
Readback is asynchronous and Bevy's bridge is latest-only. Source frame IDs and overwritten batch counts are unavailable; raw counts need not match main-loop sample counts.
The receipt window excludes already delivered pre-window samples. Late warmup results may arrive inside it; final in-flight results may be absent. No blocking drain is performed.
Only the latest measurement per path per observation is retained. Identically named spans from multiple views are not individually identified.
Nested or overlapping spans must not be summed as a whole-frame GPU or CPU duration. These are not presentation timestamps.

Unsupported means no GPU samples were received and built-in pass timestamp support is not enabled on this device. Encoder-only spans require timestamp_query and timestamp_inside_encoders but not timestamp_inside_passes; received GPU samples take precedence over the pass-support status. This does not assert that the hardware cannot support disabled features.
Upload bytes and upload duration are unmeasured. CPU mesh work counters elsewhere describe generated mesh work, not GPU transfer completion.

hardware_role: local diagnostics only; no reference PC has been selected
measurement: Instant intervals between consecutive main-world Last schedules; CPU main-loop pacing, not GPU or presented-frame timestamps

render_scene.note: Controlled rendering fixture; one circuit/train. Codec capacity is distinct from preview persistence, which is disabled. No reference PC or hardware acceptance.

render_work.scope: Current generated CPU geometry, including off-screen geometry. Four attributes plus indices (five buffers) use 48 bytes per vertex plus 4 per index; capacities, extraction clones, GPU packing/allocation, physical upload bytes/time and visibility counts are not measured. Guest buffer growths count CPU capacity changes only.

simulation.note: A wall-clock/tick shortfall alone does not count dropped simulation ticks. Virtual time caps discard long wall-clock gaps; fixed-step overstep also affects endpoint tick counts.

window.interpretation: Focus, visibility, occlusion, size and present mode must be considered before comparing FPS; unknown occlusion is not evidence of visibility. Auto modes may choose a backend fallback that this probe cannot inspect.

winit_update_policy.unfocused_mode: Reactive { wait: 16.666667ms, react_to_device_events: false, react_to_user_events: true, react_to_window_events: true }
